items.item_text: Which is larger: 9 or 12? Explain in one sentence.
items.response_format: Choose one answer and give one sentence of reasoning.
items.correct_response: 12 is larger because it has one ten and two ones, while 9 has no tens.
items.targeted_misconception: A number with more digits is always smaller.
items.expected_distractor_reasoning: Choosing 9 because 12 has more digits would be consistent with the supplied misconception.
alternative_explanations: The learner may have reversed the comparison accidentally.
items.interpretation_limit: One response cannot establish that the learner holds the misconception.
items.follow_up_probe: Which is larger: 8 or 21? Explain using place value.

interpretation_limits: Responses provide evidence to investigate, not a diagnosis.
